outcome: Maternal complications (blood product transfusion, postoperative fever)
cohort: The study included 92,887 deliveries, of which 48 cases involved emergency peripartum hysterectomies, performed at a tertiary referral hospital in Ankara, Turkey.
finding: The incidence of emergency peripartum hysterectomies was 0.51 per 1,000 deliveries, with abnormal placentation being the most common indication and no maternal mortality reported.
